The CCP's code is in three files, assembled in this order
(`src/rom.asm:27-29`). `src/cpm/ccp.asm` holds the entry, the main loop, the

commands: `DIR` with its pager, `TYPE`, `ERA`, `REN` and `COPY`. `ccpcmd.asm`
holds `UNLOAD`, `CON`, `USER` and `SAVE`, the parsing of file names, page zero

HWSPUT rejects a claimed CRT or nonvideo console before count zero, hides the cursor, bounds row and column and invokes VPUT with each clipped cell.

MOUNT validates the header and descriptors in order, calls MNONE for assigned descriptors during that pass and checks drive A at the end. Every failure reaches MNTERR and UNMOUNT.
The first eight header bytes are compared with FMTMAG, with MEMAGIC on any mismatch.
The descriptor count is divided by sixteen to obtain extra table blocks; MNBLK reads them, MNSUM accumulates them and the final comparison returns MESUM on a mismatch.
The accumulated table checksum is compared with MNTSUM and MESUM is returned through MNTERR if it differs.
Descriptor validation rejects zero id, unsupported flags, unknown geometry, nonmatching payload length and zero or unaligned start.
The descriptor payload length is compared with the geometry word and its high two bytes must be zero.
The descriptor end is added as 32 bits with carry rejection, compared against container length and limited to an exclusive 800000h for byte-addressed SD cards.
The drive must be FFh or A-D, within the optional drive count and not already assigned by a previous descriptor.
MNTDRV is decremented before comparing the drive, so zero permits every default drive while a nonzero N permits only the first N.
An empty geometry byte for drive A returns MENOA after the descriptor pass.
MNSUM copies each 32-byte piece through MNBUF and sums all sixteen pieces of the 512-byte cache line. HDRSUM in volutil subtracts the checksum bytes.
